research.title: NCETM — Unit fractions: identifying, representing and comparing
research.use: Equal parts define the unit; equal area need not imply identical shape. Compare unit sizes with the same whole.
research.ageAdaptation: English Year3 teacher guidance; adapt to frozen Finnish grades3–6, short original Finnish explanations and optional adult reading.

research.title: NCETM — Non-unit fractions: identifying, representing and comparing
research.use: Interpret a numerator as a count of units named by the denominator; include one-whole boundary. Broader comparison and addition remain beyond core.
